records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Ana replied engaged on day 6 saying they like it and just need to add the team [email:b284108f], so intent is real. But after three nudges [email:4a86550d, email:995a0a35, email:77317b5d] there is still no first project, no invite, and no milestone, and stated intent often slips. 8 days left, no tickets. Moderate odds.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on River Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Great to hear River Studio likes it so far, and that adding the rest of the team is the next step. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for the whole group.

One thing that helps the invites land well: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so having a first project in place gives everyone something real to walk into.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to set up that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
